name: RAG-RewardBench
description: RAG-RewardBench is the first benchmark designed to evaluate reward models in retrieval augmented generation (RAG) settings, focusing on preference alignment. It includes four challenging RAG-specific scenarios and diverse data sources to comprehensively assess reward models' effectiveness in guiding optimization aligned with human preferences.
reputation: A new benchmark for RAG reward-model evaluation that is early in adoption and not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes 18 RAG subsets, six retrievers, and 24 RALMs; uses LLM-as-a-judge approach for preference annotation.
